skills.name: Great Wall Guardian
skills.text: Gains Movement Speed when using dual swords. Skills and Basic Attacks apply marks to enemies. At 5 stacks, the marks detonate, dealing damage and inflicting silence and slow on the enemy.

skills.name: Great Wall Guardian
skills.text: Gains Movement Speed when using dual swords. Skills and Basic Attacks apply marks to enemies. At 5 stacks, the marks detonate, dealing damage and inflicting silence and slow on the enemy.

skills.name: Snaking Strike
skills.text: Dashes twice in the target direction, with the ability to change the direction of the 2nd dash. Deals damage to enemies in her path. If the skill hits an enemy, it can be used again before it enters cooldown.

skills.name: Sundering Slash
skills.text: Deals damage and slows enemies within range. The longer the charge, the greater the damage and slow effect. After a certain duration, launches enemies. Hitting an enemy allows the skill to be used again.

skills.name: Dagger Waltz
skills.text: Throws a sword in the target direction that slows and deals damage to enemies within range when it reaches its max range. If Mulan touches the sword, she retrieves it, reducing the cooldown of Skill 2.

skills.name: Blade Flurry
skills.text: Slashes up to 4 times in the target direction, with each slash damaging, slowing, and knocking back enemies.

skills.name: Blooming Blade
skills.text: Deals damage to enemies within range, gaining damage reduction during this time. Enhances herself, gaining Physical Attack for a period of time. Switches to heavy sword form.

skills.name: Blooming Blade
skills.text: Deals damage to enemies in range. Enhances herself, gaining Attack Speed for a period of time. Switches to dual swords.

patchHistory.summary: Increased damage reduction while wielding the heavy sword and the damage of Skill 1 when wielding both heavy and dual swords.
